Class MgrInventory

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.VBox
manager.MgrInventory
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class MgrInventory extends javafx.scene.layout.VBox
Iteems inventory page, laid out like the whiteboard sketch: item name, amount on hand, and the price modifier used when calculating customer costs. Nothing is written to the database until "Save changes" is pressed.
